sharedRules.name: Bonding Knife Ritual
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule must take 50% casualties before it must take a Panic test in the Shooting Phae instead of 25%.

sharedRules.name: Supporting Fire
sharedRules.description: All Drone type models in a unit always count as having set to Overwatch even if they made shooting attacks in the shooting phase. The rest of the models in the Drone’s unit do not have to set to Overwatch, however if charged, only the Drone models within the unit may Overwatch unless the whole unit set to Overwatch in the shooting phase. This includes Drone models embarked on Vehicles with the Drone Port Special rule.

sharedRules.name: Drone Port
sharedRules.description:
A unit with this special rule gains the following:
● It may transport 2 Drone type models as if it were a Transport. Any Drones in this unit start docked during deployment.
● Embarked Drone models in this transport can shoot and Fight in the shooting Phase and Combat Phase while embarked in this model as if the model had the Assault Vehicle special rule.
● Drones purchased as part of a unit with this special rule may disembark but are part of the unit it was purchased with and must maintain coherency with the model with this special rule. If the Model with the Drone Port is destroyed, the Drones become their own unit.
● When the model with this special rule is destroyed, the Drone models must perform an emergency disembarkation following the standard rules for doing so found in the core rules. If the embarked Drones were purchased as part of the unit which had this special rule, any surviving Drones after performing emergency disembarkation become their own unit and may not embark on another unit with this special rule.

sharedRules.name: Devour, Grow Stronger
sharedRules.description: Units with this special rule gain the Preferred Enemy (Infantry, Monster & Cavalry) and Monster Hunter special rules.

sharedRules.name: Multi Spectral Eyes
sharedRules.description: Vespid units with this special rule have the Night Vision Special Rule. In addition, Vespid ignore all negative modifiers to their Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic and all Snap Shots are made at full Ballistic Skill (BS).

sharedRules.name: Blacksun Filter
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Night vision special rule and is not affected by the Blind Special Rule.

sharedRules.name: Velocity Tracker
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with this wargear, may treat all Shooting Weapons it is equipped with as having the Skyfire special rule when targeting Aircraft type units.

sharedRules.name: Shield Generator
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with this support system gains a 4+ invulnerable save.

sharedRules.name: Advanced Targeting System
sharedRules.description: A model with this wargear has the Firing Protocol (3) special rule on all of their ranged weapons.

sharedRules.name: Drone Controller
sharedRules.description: Any Drones attached to a unit with this wargear may use the equipped models Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic instead of their own.

sharedRules.name: Stealth Field
sharedRules.description: A unit which includes a model with this special rule always counts as gaining the benefits of Light Cover. If the unit is already benefiting from Light Cover, it gains the benefit of Heavy Cover instead.

sharedRules.name: Combat Armour
sharedRules.description: This lightweight high performance combat armour integrating advanced systems is the standard of the Fire Warriors. This confers a 4+ Armour save.

sharedRules.name: Kroot Hide
sharedRules.description: Kroot hide is noted to be very leathery. It confers a 6+ Armour save. Or confers a 5+ Armour save if the unit is the Beast or Cavalry and a 4+ Armour save if the unit is a Monster type.

sharedRules.name: Heavy Plate
sharedRules.description: Hardened armour found on Battlesuits and light skimmer vehicles. It confers a 3+ Armour save.

sharedRules.name: Vespid Carapace
sharedRules.description: The Vespid insect carapace is hardened like natural armour. It confers a 4+ Armour save.

sharedRules.name: Recon Armour
sharedRules.description: This stripped-down version of the main combat armour is designed for increased mobility and typically issued to Pathfinders at the cost of protection. This confers a 5+ Armour save.

sharedRules.name: Super Heavy Plate
sharedRules.description: Hardened armour found on large Battlesuits. It confers a 2+ Armour save.

sharedRules.name: Decoy Launchers
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with this Wargear can set to Deploy Decoys instead of setting to Overwatch. Until the start of its next turn, the model gains a 4+ Cover Save.

sharedRules.name: Flechette Launchers
sharedRules.description: A model with this wargear increases the number of Hammer of Wrath attacks it makes when it attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: Disruption Pods
sharedRules.description: A model with this wargear always gains the benefit of Light Cover even if it would not normally benefit from Cover. If the unit is already benefitting from Light Cover, it gains the benefit of Heavy Cover instead.

sharedRules.name: Sensor Spines
sharedRules.description: This unit gains the Move Through Cover special rule.

sharedRules.name: Puretide Engram Neurochip
sharedRules.description: If your army includes a model with this Relic wargear, you can select 2 units in your army to gain either the Outflank, Scout or Infiltrate special rules.

sharedRules.name: The Fusion Blades
sharedRules.description: may exchange a Plasma Blasters for 2 Fusion Blades for 15pts.

sharedRules.name: Swarm Caller
sharedRules.description: At the start of your Movement Phase, you can select a single Vespid Stingwings unit that can draw visibility to this Vespid Warlord. The selected unit regains D3 lost models. These models must be placed within coherency of existing models in the unit.

sharedRules.name: Repulsor Impact Field
sharedRules.description: A model with this Relic may always make its Hammer of Wrath (x) attacks at initiative step 10, even if the equipped model did not perform a Charge that Phase.

sharedRules.name: The Onager Guantlet
sharedRules.description: One unit in your army with the Battlesuit type

sharedRules.name: Failsafe Detonator
sharedRules.description: When a model with this relic is slain and removed from play, all units within 5” of the equipped model before it is removed from play take 2D6, Strength 5, AP- automatic hits

sharedRules.name: Crisis Suit Bodyguards
sharedRules.description: This unit can only join units of Crisis Suit Teams.

sharedRules.name: Master of Mont'ka
sharedRules.description: If a model with this Warlord trait did not remain stationary in the Movement Phase, they may re-roll Wound and Penetration Rolls.

sharedRules.name: Master of Rinyon
sharedRules.description: If you army includes a model with this Warlord Trait, you may give 1 T’au unit the Outflank Special rule during Deployment. In addition, while this Warlord is alive, you may re-roll the results for units arriving via Deep Strike or Outflank.

sharedRules.name: Master of Kauyon
sharedRules.description: A model with this trait gains the Infiltrate special rule. A model with this trait may perform Overwatch attacks at a range of 18” instead of 12” at the end of your opponent’s Charge Phase if there are no enemy models within 3”.

sharedRules.name: Master of Rip'kya
sharedRules.description: Once per game, this unit and its attached unit may make 1 additional attack with all ‘Pulse’ and ‘Missile’ weapons they are equipped with when performing a Shooting Attack in the Shooting Phase. This does not change the weapons type; they only make 1 extra attack when shooting with the weapon when performing an attack. A ‘Pulse’ or ‘Missile’ Weapon is any weapon listed under the ‘Pulse’ or ‘Missile’ category of the Wargear section.

sharedRules.name: Water Caste Connections
sharedRules.description: Once per game, an Ethereal model with this trait can summon 1 unit of Kroot Carnivores which arrive via Outflank or 1 unit of Vespid Stingwings which arrive via Deep Strike.

sharedRules.name: Invoker of the Elements
sharedRules.description: Once per game, an Ethereal model with this trait can summon 2 units of Tactical Drones which arrive via Outflank.

sharedRules.name: Master of the Hunt
sharedRules.description: If your army includes a Kroot unit with this Warlord Trait during deployment, you may redeploy up to 3 of your units after the Deployment Step is finished but before the first turn begins.

sharedRules.name: Flesh Hunger
sharedRules.description: A Kroot model with this Warlord trait gains +1 to their Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristics. The Warlord gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

sharedRules.name: Strange Blessings
sharedRules.description: A Kroot model with this Warlord Trait gains the Adamantium Will and Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rules.

sharedRules.name: Communion Vector
sharedRules.description: A Vespid model with this Warlord trait and any attached unit gains the Stubborn special rule and +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristics.

sharedRules.name: Blood Wing
sharedRules.description: A Vespid model with this Warlord trait gains the Rage special rule and increases their Strength (S) and Attacks (A) characteristic by 1.

sharedRules.name: Homing Beacon
sharedRules.description: Friendly T’au units that Deep Strike wholly within 12” of this model do not scatter.

sharedRules.name: Fire Warrior Bodyguards
sharedRules.description: This unit can only join Fire Warrior Teams.

sharedRules.name: Fire Warrior Leader
sharedRules.description: This unit can only join Fire Warrior Teams or Pathfinder teams.

sharedRules.name: Icon of the Greater Good
sharedRules.description: If this unit is slain, your opponent gains 1 Victory Point.

sharedRules.name: Inspiring Figure
sharedRules.description:
Friendly T’au units that do not have the Auxiliary keyword that can draw visibility to this unit gain the
Stubborn Special Rule.

sharedRules.name: Hazard Strike
sharedRules.description:
This units ranged weapons gain the Melee type and Range while within 3” of an enemy unit in the
Combat Phase.

sharedRules.name: Wings
sharedRules.description: This unit has a Movement (M) characteristic of 12”. It gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep Strike special rules.
